ajustes.descripcion: With review on, what an editor schedules doesn't go out until a reviewer of {marca} approves it. What a reviewer schedules is approved automatically.
ajustes.activa: Review clips before they go out
ajustes.alVencer: If the time comes and nobody reviewed it
ajustes.noPublicarAyuda: It stays “Overdue, not reviewed” until someone approves it.
ajustes.publicarIgualAyuda: It goes out on time and is marked “Went out unreviewed”. Clips with requested changes don't go out.
ajustes.soloPropietario: Only the brand owner can change this.
ajustes.revisoresAyuda: The owner and anyone with the Reviewer role always review. Invite a client who only approves as a Reviewer. If an editor also approves, mark them with “Reviews”.

chequeo.soloPropietario: Right now only the owner reviews: everything the team schedules will land on that person, and if it isn't approved in time it won't go out. To share the load, invite someone as a Reviewer or mark an editor with “Reviews”.
chequeo.sinEditores: Everyone who schedules clips is a reviewer, and what a reviewer schedules is approved automatically: review won't hold anything back until there's an editor who doesn't review.

programar.aviso: This brand reviews clips before publishing: this will stay “To review” until a reviewer approves it.
programar.avisoRevisor: You're a reviewer: what you schedule is approved.
